extracted.name: Mushroom Slow Cooker Roast Beef
extracted.description: This slow cooker roast beef with mushrooms is made with just 5 ingredients and turns out fall-off-the-bone tender. Shred leftovers for cheesesteaks.
instruction_lines: Place the mushrooms in the bottom of a slow cooker; set the beef roast atop the mushrooms; sprinkle the onion soup mix over the beef and pour the beer over everything; season with black pepper.
Cook on Low until the meat is easily pulled apart with a fork, 9 to 10 hours.
